editorial.name: Moonchild AI
editorial.descriptionZh: 把 PRD 贴进去，用团队已有设计系统拼出可用界面稿，确认后通过一条 MCP 连接把设计导出成代码给 Claude Code 或 Cursor。
editorial.takeawayZh: 把 PRD 粘进去，出可导出成代码的界面稿
editorial.noteZh: 首屏标语 Stop designing from scratch，副文案写 Your design system already has the pieces. Moonchild assembles them. Paste a PRD, get production-ready screens. Export to code when it's right.，下面两个计数器是 594K+ PROTOTYPES GENERATED 与 70K+ DESIGNS EXPORTED，右侧一段 0:58 的产品演示停在成排深色仪表盘截图上。往下 Built for every role on the team 拆成三段：PRODUCT MANAGERS 那栏写 Paste a PRD, get screens in minutes，DESIGNERS 写 You art direct the output，DEVELOPERS 直接点明 One MCP connection. Designs flow into Claude Code or Cursor。Made with Moonchild 挂着 Wandr Travel Muse Canvas Future of Design 三个样例，页脚导航是 BLOG、PRICING、DISCORD、GUIDE。
editorial.pricing: unknown（站内有 /pricing 与 Sign up，抓取到的首页未给免费或档位口径）

reasons.statement: 用户拿到的是可评审的界面稿与原型：首屏写 get production-ready screens，Made with Moonchild 一段也标注 Sample projects designed from brief to prototype—in minutes。
归 ui-prototyping-whiteboard 而非 design-to-code-handoff：导代码只是末端一步，前面 01 PRD to UI Screens、02 Exploring User Flows、03 UX Problem Solving 才是主体的设计过程。
